obligation: test of the PRE-REGISTERED organ-gate threshold (receipts/odyssey-i/O00X_PREREG_ORGAN_GATE_THRESHOLD.json)
VERDICT: THE PRE-REGISTERED THRESHOLD IS REFUTED. The weaker ordering claim survives.

what_was_declared_in_advance.prediction: at 4 bits, every MLP organ with r99 below 0.35 gains; every organ above 0.35 does not

the_refutation_in_one_line: w1/w3 sit at r99 0.345, which is below the declared threshold of 0.35, so the threshold predicted they would gain. They lost 0.0117 held-out top-1 at 4 bits. That is a refutation by 0.005 of r99.
why_the_near_miss_is_the_point_and_not_a: A threshold of 0.30 would have passed. That is EXACTLY why it was pre-registered. Moving it now to accommodate the result would convert a refutation into the same post-hoc fit the pre-registration existed to prevent, and the fitted value would once again predict nothing. The threshold is refuted at 0.35 and is not being moved.

what_survives.claim: the WITHIN-MODEL ORDERING -- the organ with lower r99 gains more than the organ with higher r99
what_survives.so: 3/3 at 4 bits, 2/3 at 3 bits. Real but not universal, and it orders organs rather than deciding whether to treat any of them.

gptq_all_vs_best_single_organ.Falcon3-1B: all-MLP is BEST at both widths
gptq_all_vs_best_single_organ.LFM2.5-1.2B: all-MLP is WORST at both widths (4b 0.7869 vs rtn 0.7947; 3b 0.5484 vs rtn 0.6432)

and_the_practical_advice_still_does_not_.conclusion: three specimens, three different answers to 'which organs should be treated'. There is no transferable configuration rule yet.

a_further_negative: On LFM2.5 at 3 bits EVERY activation-aware arm is WORSE than round-to-nearest (gainer -0.0147, loser -0.0714, all -0.0948). The 2-bit inversion found on Qwen3-0.6B arrives a whole bit earlier here, so 'compensation inverts below three bits' is itself specimen-dependent.

verifier.note: 0.0108, under the 0.05 bar, so the verifier rejects a destroyed body on this specimen too

what_hawking_does_differently_next: Do NOT spend a GPU window or a deep search on activation-aware organ selection for a new body on the strength of a prior body's configuration. The r99 ordering is worth computing (seconds) as a RANKING, but which organs to treat, and whether to treat any at 3 bits, must be measured per specimen with a matched-EBPW control. That is a cheap 4-arm sweep and it is now the prescribed procedure rather than an inherited setting.
